pages.text: Brew and collect Green Tea from a Tea Kettle.

pages.title: The Kettle Sings
pages.text: Turn processed leaves into a drink.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: You need water, heat, dried leaves and a serving container. JEI shows the Green Tea brewing recipe.

pages.title: Brew tea and coffee
pages.text: The kettle separates ingredients, water, heat and output. Recipes consume water and heat; the Copper Kettle follows the same sequence.

pages.title: Share tea effects
pages.text: Some teas share effects with nearby players and can become weaker with more recipients. A second player is not required in singleplayer.
